body:
> "it doesn't work like RT" is not an argument I'm particularly sensitive about.

Understood! The differences are already "staggering", and ART is far beyond RT in every aspect I had a look at (I especially appreciate the vastly improved "Inspect" tab, and that the sliders in the various settings react to double click by resetting to the default value is very helpful). Since I started to use RT last year and only lately found out about ART, my comparisons should be rather seen as "observations" (or mild suggestions ;-)). 

Regarding documentation -- I might be of help in this regard, as I did Technical Writing and Technical Documentation for a living for some time (not any more, though). But documentation is not what most users refer to anyways these days ... ;-)
